Estimated resident population of Victorian local government areas

Source: R/data_vic_population.R
vic_population.Rd

Estimated resident population of each Victorian local government area (LGA) at 30 June, 2012 to 2025.

Usage

vic_population

Format

A tibble with 1,120 rows and 4 columns:

lga_code

(character) ABS LGA code.

lga_name

(character) LGA name in capitals, spelled as in vic_lga and vic_crashes.

year

(integer) Year (population at 30 June).

population

(numeric) Estimated resident population.

Source

Australian Bureau of Statistics, Regional population, 2024-25 (Cat. no. 3218.0), dataset ERP_LGA2025, https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/people/population/regional-population/2024-25, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Retrieved 25 October 2026. Changes made: kept Victorian LGAs for 2012 to 2025; renamed columns; LGA names in capitals without the "(Vic.)" suffix.
